run_ImageClassificationPipeline: run the ImageClassificationPipeline to classify images and return top labeled results with scores
test_postprocess: test the postprocess method to apply sigmoid, softmax, or no function on model logits and return sorted label-score pairs
build_ImageClassificationPipeline: build an ImageClassificationPipeline with a model for image classification and optional top_k and function_to_apply parameters
test_ClassificationFunction: test the ClassificationFunction enum to select sigmoid, softmax, or none for transforming model output scores
review_sigmoid_softmax: review the sigmoid and softmax utility functions that transform raw model outputs into probability scores
